ihope-community-sbc-north-tonawanda-ny.gender_detail: SBC complementarian per BF&M 2000 Article VI.

ihopkc-kansas-city.assessment: IHOPKC was founded by Mike Bickle and built around 24/7 prayer and worship — a compelling vision, but the theological framework is deeply problematic. Bickle was removed after credible abuse allegations spanning decades. The organization operates within a New Apostolic Reformation (NAR) framework that elevates extra-biblical revelation, prophetic authority, and apostolic governance over Scripture. This is a disqualified institution: abuse scandal, NAR theology, personality-cult leadership, and lack of genuine accountability. Not recommended under any circumstances.

score_notes.christology: Basic Christology affirmed but blurred by NAR 'prophetic' emphasis.
score_notes.scripture: Extra-biblical revelation elevated alongside or above Scripture — direct prophecy, dreams, visions treated as authoritative.
score_notes.gender: Not complementarian or patriarchal — NAR framework with mixed leadership.
score_notes.leadership: Catastrophic failure — founder removed for abuse spanning decades; cult-like authority structure.
score_notes.soteriology: Blurred by mystical emphasis and experiential theology.
score_notes.cultural: Deeply enmeshed in NAR culture; extreme charismatic practices.
score_notes.mission: Prayer movement focus replaces Great Commission clarity.
score_notes.denominational: Independent with no genuine accountability — proved catastrophically.
